Vous intervenez sur un périmètre N3 avec une double casquette : expertise technique et contribution aux projets d’évolution réseau. Vous êtes un acteur clé du maintien en condition opérationnelle et de l'amélioration continue des infrastructures, avec une vision transverse allant du support avancé à la qualification des architectures. Vos Missions Contribuer aux phases projet en collaboration avec un architecte, tester et qualifier les solutions et versions avant mise en production Gérer les changements réseau à forte complexité Réaliser l’intégration et le déploiement des évolutions réseau (ex : sujets Core Réseau, SD-WAN, montées de version, nouveaux équipements) MCO des équipements réseaux du cœur de réseau Optimiser le parc réseau : déploiement de scripts, hardening des infrastructures Rédiger et maintenir des procédures et modes opératoires Prendre en charge les incidents complexes de niveau 3 et assurer leur résolution Apporter un soutien technique à l’équipe exploitation Participer à l’amélioration continue (qualité, performance, MCO) Environnement technique PALO ALTO NETWORKS: Firewall NGFW (PA-Series), Panorama, GlobalProtect VPN, Prisma Access (SASE), Prisma Cloud, Cortex XDR FORTINET: FortiGate NGFW, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer CISCO: Routeurs (ASR, Catalyst), Switches Catalyst/Nexus, Webex F5 : BigIp EKINOPS: SDWAN, OneAccess AWS: VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, CloudFront, WAF, Shield, Security Groups, Network Firewall, CloudWatch OKTA : Identity Management, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Lifecycle Management, API Access Management TENABLE : Nessus (scanner de vulnérabilités), Tenable.io, Tenable.sc (Security Center), Vulnerability Management, Web App Scanning OS: Linux Debian, Windows server 2016/2025, Windows 11 SYSTEME: Docker, Squid , PowerDNS, Bind, LDAP, Radius, Tacacs+, AD, Syslog, LogStash Profil Vous disposez d’une expérience validée en environnement N2/N3 réseau. Vous avez la capacité d’intervenir sur l’intégration de solutions réseau, les incidents réseaux sur des environnements LAN et WAN. Compétences Solide socle réseau : TCP/IP, modèle OSI, routage (OSPF, BGP), WAN, IPsec Bonne maîtrise des environnements sécurité (Firewall – Palo Alto souhaité, Fortinet apprécié) Connaissances des services réseau : DNS, HTTPS, SSL, SNMP Bonne pratique des méthodes ITIL (MCO, gestion des incidents, problèmes et changements) Les certifications CCNA/CCNP, Palo Alto seront des atouts pour ce poste. Savoir-être Esprit d’équipe Autonomie et rigueur Capacité d’analyse et sens du diagnostic Envie d’apprendre et de progresser dans un environnement technique exigeant Pourquoi nous rejoindre et notre process Un poste N3 structurant au cœur des enjeux réseau Une équipe expérimentée et des sujets techniques variés (infra, SD-WAN, évolution des architectures) Un environnement favorisant la montée en compétences et l’autonomie

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.location: WP. Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
review_candidates.description: Company Description We are a system integrator providing network, security, and ELV solutions to enterprise, government, and commercial clients across Malaysia. Our projects include network design, implementation, migration, troubleshooting, and post-deployment support for mission-critical environments. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role for a Network Engineer (Vendor / System Integrator) based in WP Kuala Lumpur. The Network Engineer will be responsible for designing, deploying, configuring, and supporting network solutions at client sites. The role involves hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, documentation, and collaboration with internal project teams and clients to ensure successful project delivery and operational stability. The candidate must be comfortable working in project-based environments, supporting multiple clients, and performing on-site work, including troubleshooting during critical situations. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and configure network solutions for client projects Perform on-site installation, migration, and commissioning of network systems Troubleshoot and resolve network issues during implementation and support phases Support LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VLAN, routing, and network security configurations Work closely with project managers, vendors, and client technical teams Prepare technical documentation, as-built drawings, and handover reports Provide post-implementation support and assist during warranty or SLA periods Participate in site surveys, PoC, and technical discussions with clients Perform detail site inspection & reports Qualifications / Requirements Required Strong hands-on experience in Network Engineering or Network Administration Solid troubleshooting skills for LAN, WAN, and Wi-Fi environments Good understanding of network security concepts and best practices Ability to work independently & in group at client sites and under project timelines Good communication skills for interacting with clients and internal teams Willingness to travel to client sites when required Preferred/ Advantage Experience with enterprise networking vendors (e.g. Cisco, Ruckus, Aruba, Fortinet, Sangfor, HPE, Alcatel-Lucent, etc.) Experience in system integrator or vendor environments Knowledge of Wi-Fi design, surveys, or large-scale deployments Relevant certifications (CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent) Experience supporting government or enterprise clients Education Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field Diploma holders with strong hands-on experience are encouraged to apply

review_candidates.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. Verizon Global Infrastructure (VGI) is looking for an innovative and driven leader with a passion for Cybersecurity and Technology. This role will work on securing the network and infrastructure devices, hardening the operating systems and building use cases to automate these tasks. This role will partner and work closely with key cross-functional stakeholders, like Verizon Cybersecurity (VCS), Global Network & Technology (GNT) Network Security, and our GTS Enterprise Network teams, in order to protect our network and align on proactive security measures to effectively mitigate risks, enable safe digital transformation, and defend against emerging threats and vulnerabilities. What We’re Looking For… Supporting daily operations, including internal/external stakeholder engagement and dotted-line leadership. Leveraging industry proven tools to identify and reduce Cyber Risks Implementing next generation network security architecture, create advanced policies and controls against future threats Ensuring effectiveness and coverage of security, policies and controls of VGS Network & Infrastructure, prioritizing risk level. Ensuring Security posture of GTS Network & Infrastructure, e.g., access management, vulnerabilities remediation, etc. Developing awareness, training & compliance programs focused on Network & Infrastructure Cyber Security practices. Coordinating activities like network, penetration testing, incident response, data collection etc by partnering with the CISO teams. Assisting in Crisis Management, Ransomware Recovery and Business Continuity planning. Developing and maintaining network and infrastructure security reporting dashboards and scorecards used to measure our Cyber Practice. Identifying opportunities and use cases for automation to remediate vulnerabilities, implement controls, orchestrate between tools and automate security practices. Promoting an environment of collaboration and individual accountability when it comes to problem-solving, decision-making, and process improvements You’ll Need To Have Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. Two or more years of experience in Information Security, Technology or Technical Risk Analysis. Two or more years of experience with assessing existing controls, policies, procedures, and technologies to understand the organization's current security posture. Understanding of network fundamentals, switching, routing protocols, load balancers, web proxies, firewalls and software defined networking solutions. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity, network defense, and investigative frameworks (such as NIST CSF, ISO 27000 series, MITRE ATT&CK, Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain, etc.) into network defense processes High-level understanding of Cloud Environments (AWS, Azure, OCI) and Operating Systems (Windows, Unix/Linux, and OSX) Experience working in any one of the SIEM / SOAR solutions like Splunk SOAR, Cortex XSOAR by Palo Alto Networks, IBM Security QRadar SOAR, Swimlane etc Understanding on how to develop and configure dashboards and visualizations with tools like Grafana. Expertise with scripting and programming (i.e. Python) for automation of data parsing, API interactions, and custom tool development. Strong database skills such as SQL for querying, analyzing, and managing large databases Experience in creating, modifying, and executing Ansible playbooks for automation, configuration management, and orchestration of security deployments across diverse network devices and servers. Experience in design and implementation of network security solutions like firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, VPN , web proxies etc using vendor products like Cisco, Juniper, Checkpoint, Palo Alto etc Certifications like: Network+, Security+, CISSP or CISM If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.
